25.sql:
SELECT sc.`School`, f.`Charter Funding Type`
FROM schools AS sc
JOIN satscores AS ss ON sc.`CDSCode` = ss.cds
JOIN frpm AS f ON sc.`CDSCode` = f.`CDSCode`
WHERE sc.`County` = 'Riverside'
  AND ss.`AvgScrMath` > 400;

stats.gold_sql: SELECT T1.sname, T2.`Charter Funding Type` FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.`District Name` LIKE 'Riverside%' GROUP BY T1.sname, T2.`Charter Funding Type` HAVING CAST(SUM(T1.AvgScrMath) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.cds) > 400

cte_path.cte:
WITH c_cols AS (
    SELECT ss.cds, ss.`AvgScrMath`, f.`Charter Funding Type`
    FROM satscores AS ss
    INNER JOIN frpm AS f ON ss.cds = f.`CDSCode`
    INNER JOIN schools AS sc ON ss.cds = sc.`CDSCode`
    WHERE sc.`County` = 'Riverside'
)
SELECT * FROM c_cols;

WITH t_join AS (
    SELECT r.cds, r.`Charter Funding Type`
    FROM c_rows r
    INNER JOIN schools s ON r.cds = s.`CDSCode`
    WHERE s.`County` = 'Riverside'
)
SELECT * FROM t_join;
